raw.title: ESSP Senior Lead Protection Engineer
raw.excerpt: This OpportunityWSP is currently initiating a search for an ESSPSenior Lead Protection Engineer for our Bosie, ID office.
raw.description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for an ESSPSenior Lead Protection Engineer for our Bosie, ID office. Candidates for our Orlando, FL; Freeport, ME; Syracuse, NY; Charlotte, NC; Overland Park, KS; and Richmond, VA offices will also be considered. The ability to work remotely from a mutually acceptable location in the United States will be considered (please note in the application questions where you prefer to be located).Be involved in projects with our Electrical Studies, SCADA, and Protection (ESSP) team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.

WSP brings global expertise in power delivery, power generation, and program management anchored by the acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. TRC Companies have now joined WSP, deepening our power practice and expanding our energy advisory and intelligent grid services. We're partnering with clients to shape how energy systems evolve around the world—and we need your help.

The successful applicant will have a direct role in the design, engineering, and studies of protection systems for equipment on the bulk power system. This includes the protection of substations, transmission lines, generators, renewables, industrial, and distribution systems.

Your Impact:

Candidates for this role will have extensive knowledge, proven experience, and advanced expertise with many of the items listed below. However, mastery of all these technical areas is not required. The successful candidate will be responsible for using their extensive knowledge and expertise to develop new clients, make strategic decisions, and lead projects and teams.

  • Protective Relaying: Symmetrical component analysis, protection philosophy development, relay settings, and integration with SCADA systems.
  • Protection Analyses: Electrical model development, short circuit, time-current coordination, arc flash, NERC compliance, and event analysis
  • Leadership: Lead teams on client projects to meet the scope, schedule, and budget. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Data Acquisition: Support infrequent onsite site visits to collect data and able to discuss project specifics at appropriate technical level for clients.
  • Industry Standards: Working knowledge or awareness of applicable industry practices for protection as outlined in IEEE, ANSI, or NERC PRC standards.
  • Organized: Flexibility to support a variety of project schedules to meet client needs and able to prioritize responsibilities effectively.
  • Applicable software: AcSELeratorQuickset, GEEnervista, ASPENOneliner, CAPE, SKM-PTW, ETAP, RSCAD
  • Applicable hardware: SEL, GE, Siemens, ABB, Beckwith, RTDS
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (ABET accredited).
  • 12+ years of relevant post education experience as an electrical engineer executing deliverables for Protective Relaying projects in power generation, transmission, and distribution at a utility, industrial, or commercial scale.
  • Professional Engineering (PE) license or ability to obtain one.
  • Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Preference will be given to applicants with a proven history of leading and completing similar projects in a consulting environment.
  • Preference may be given to engineers with commissioning and testing experience, or strong skills in protecting equipment at high voltages (69kV and higher).
  • Preference is also given to applicants with experience mentoring others and a willingness to do so.

Disclaimer:
 • Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Salary (New York only): $153,600yr - $260,200yr

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

raw.description:
D-ploy is a dynamic IT and Engineering Solutions company operating across the EMEA region, including Switzerland, Germany, Czech Republic, Austria, the UK, and the USA. We are committed to delivering reliable and efficient services to our clients through strong partnerships and a people-focused culture.

We are looking for an experienced Network Engineer to support and manage enterprise network infrastructure, with a strong focus on Check Point Firewalls, Proxy Services, and Cisco LAN/WLAN environments. The role covers day-to-day operations, troubleshooting, security changes, and infrastructure improvements.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Check Point perimeter and internal firewalls.
  • Manage firewall security policies, access rules, NAT configurations, and interface changes.
  • Perform firewall upgrades, patching, maintenance, and lifecycle activities.
  • Implement and review firewall changes in accordance with change management processes, using Tufin where applicable.
  • Configure and troubleshoot VPN solutions, including Site-to-Site VPNs and remote connectivity.
  • Conduct firewall rule reviews and support security policy optimization.
  • Manage enterprise proxy infrastructure, including configuration changes, maintenance, and software updates.
  • Support non-proxy application integrations, plugins, and S-Box configurations.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity issues and resolve incidents related to firewall, proxy, and network services.
  • Administer Cisco LAN/WLAN infrastructure, including switches, VLANs, routing, Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs), and Access Points.
  • Perform firmware upgrades, patching, performance optimization, and troubleshooting across Cisco network environments.
  • Support DDI services, including DNS, DHCP, and IP Address Management (IPAM).
  • Administer Network Access Control (NAC) solutions and access policies.
  • Support MPLS connectivity and enterprise network integrations.
  • Execute network changes and contribute to incident and problem management.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to analyze requirements and implement appropriate network solutions.

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on experience with Check Point Firewalls, including security policies, VPNs, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
  • Good knowledge of Proxy technologies and network security concepts.
  • Practical experience with Cisco LAN and WLAN technologies, including switching, routing, VLANs, WLCs, and Access Points.
  • Good understanding of VPN, MPLS, NAC, DNS, DHCP, and IPAM services.
  • Experience working with enterprise network infrastructure and IT service management processes.
  • Experience with change management and structured network troubleshooting.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.
  • Knowledge of Tufin or similar firewall policy management solutions is an advantage.
  • Check Point CCSA/CCSE or Cisco CCNA/CCNP certification is an advantage.
  • Experience in large enterprise environments and ITIL-based operations is a plus.
  • Russian language skills are a plus.
  • If successful, candidates must be able to provide a clear criminal record certificate that is no older than 3 months.

Benefits

  • Broad range of activities, tasks, and projects
  • Paid sick days
  • Vouchers (B-day voucher, wedding, and new born surprise)
  • Contributions to wellness programs (multisport card)
  • Fishing for Friends program – our referral program
  • Further development and professional advancement
  • Friendly and international working environment
  • Company-sponsored events

Is IT in your DNA?

Bilgewater Group is a Chicago-based diversified services company founded in 2003. We operate across two core divisions: food service and care.

Our food service division manages a network of quick-service and counter-service locations across the greater Chicagoland area, serving thousands of customers every day at high-traffic venues, including commercial districts, transit hubs, and retail centers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Logistics Coordinator to help coordinate day-to-day logistics activities, track orders and deliveries, and keep information flowing between internal teams, locations, and external partners. This role is ideal for someone organized, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a remote environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Coordinate orders, deliveries, and routine logistics requests

  • Track shipments, deliveries, and scheduled activities

  • Communicate with vendors, locations, and internal teams regarding logistics needs

  • Maintain accurate delivery, order, and logistics records

  • Follow up on delays, missing information, or delivery issues

  • Update spreadsheets and internal systems with logistics information

  • Support the resolution of routine logistics and scheduling issues

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Previous experience in logistics, operations, administration, customer service, or a similar role

  • Strong organization and attention to detail

  • Good communication and follow-up skills

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets and digital systems

  • Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines

  • Practical problem-solving skills and a proactive approach

  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment

  • Reliable internet connection and workspace

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States

NICE TO HAVE

  • Previous logistics or transportation coordination experience

  • Experience with inventory, order management, or scheduling systems

  • Experience in food service, retail, hospitality, or distribution

COMPENSATION

$45,000–$60,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

HIRING PROCESS

Application Review → Initial Conversation → Interview → Offer

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Bilgewater Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and value a diverse team with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Location: Remote

Salary Range: 45,000 - 60,000 USD (gross, annually)

raw.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.
  • Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.
  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.
  • Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.
  • Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.
  • Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.
  • Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.
  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.
  • Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.
  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.
  • Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.
  • Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.
Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

raw.description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Shape the Future of Commercial Auto Insurance

GEICO is seeking a highly motivated Assistant Product Manager to join our Commercial Auto Product Management Team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in developing and enhancing products that deliver value to customers while supporting GEICO's continued growth and success.

As an Assistant Product Manager, you will partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, and Design to identify opportunities, define solutions, and deliver impactful product enhancements. You will help drive products from concept to launch while leveraging data and customer insights to make informed business decisions.

If you are analytical, customer-focused, intellectually curious, and energized by solving challenging problems, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do

As an Assistant Product Manager, you will:

  • Identify opportunities to improve products, processes, and customer experiences through data analysis and stakeholder feedback.
  • Gather business requirements and translate complex problems into clear and actionable product solutions.
  • Research, develop, and prioritize product enhancements that align with business objectives.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Operations teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Monitor product performance and leverage key metrics to measure business outcomes and identify future opportunities.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned products and initiatives.
  • Support product launches, process improvements, stakeholder communications, and training efforts.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and business cases to leadership and cross-functional partners.

What Makes You Successful

The ideal candidate is:

  • Customer-focused and committed to delivering outstanding experiences.
  • An analytical thinker who enjoys solving complex business challenges.
  • Naturally curious and eager to learn new technologies, tools, and business concepts.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Skilled at influencing stakeholders and building strong working relationships across teams.
  • Organized and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Results-oriented with a bias toward action and continuous improvement.

Leadership Competencies

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

Strategic Thinking

  • Uses data and business insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
  • Connects day-to-day work to broader organizational goals and customer needs.

Collaboration and Influence

  • Builds effective partnerships across teams and functions.
  • Communicates clearly and adapts messaging for diverse audiences.

Ownership and Accountability

  • Takes initiative and follows through on commitments.
  • Demonstrates accountability for results and continuously seeks improvement.

Customer Focus

  • Advocates for customer needs when evaluating product decisions.
  • Balances business objectives with customer outcomes.

Innovation and Curiosity

  • Challenges assumptions and explores new approaches.
  • Embraces learning and seeks opportunities to improve products and processes.

Adaptability

  • Thrives in a changing environment and effectively navigates ambiguity.
  • Maintains focus and productivity while managing competing priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in insurance, product management, business analysis, or a related field.
  • Experience within the auto insurance industry required; Commercial Auto experience preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience translating business needs into product requirements and actionable solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and managing competing priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis techniques.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience identifying and tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Experience using data to measure product performance and business impact.
  • Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI, Python, R, SAS, SQL, or similar platforms.

Why GEICO?

At GEICO, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career while making a meaningful impact on products that serve millions of customers. We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning thrive.

Our Total Rewards Program includes:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Premier Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance with no waiting period*
  • Paid Vacation, Sick Leave, and Parental Leave
  • 401(k) plan with company benefits
  • Tuition Assistance through direct billing and reimbursement options
  • Professional development opportunities, training, certifications, and licensing support
  • Employee Resource Groups that foster community and belonging
  • Career growth opportunities across a leading organization

Join GEICO and help shape the future of Commercial Auto insurance through innovation, data-driven decision making, and customer-focused product development.

Annual Salary

$91,225.00 - $172,200.00

Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

OEC provides software solutions to those who work in the automotive parts and repair industry. Our solutions make it easier for automotive industry professionals to buy and sell parts, conduct repair research & planning, optimize estimates, improve the parts supply chain, and more. OEC partners with many of the world’s largest manufacturers, dealers and suppliers, shops and repairers, and service providers, giving our customers access to a comprehensive network and a streamlined workflow.

Job Summary Our Canadian French Sales Account Executive role is an inside sales position that drives revenue and attains sales goals primarily through outbound sales calls to our Canadian French speaking customer population and potential clients. Develops and implements sales plans to achieve or exceed revenue targets. Generates new revenue-producing business via phone and virtual meetings. Educates customers on benefits of utilizing OEC’s suite of Dealer software platforms and services.

This is a position that requires candidates to have bilingual written and speaking proficiency in English and Canadian French. Qualified applicants must reside within the United States and hold work authorization in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drives all aspects of the sales cycle from prospect identification to sale closure, including qualification, deal development, quotations and contracting.
  • Makes outbound calls and hosts virtual appointments to sell OEC's SaaS products and related services through a transactional and solution-based sales approach.
  • Assesses territory using creative approaches and implements sales plans to achieve or exceed revenue targets.
  • Maintains a high level of customer activity with a tenacious, driven and resilient spirit in attaining sales.
  • Works closely with Customer Success team to ensure newly enrolled customers are set up for success.
  • Develops relationships to be able to sell to new prospects and maintains current relationships to sell package upgrades and/or add-on opportunities.
  • Receives incoming requests for sales information from customers and prospects, responds to questions, and suggests OEC solutions that could result in additional product, service or upgrade sales.
  • Creates standard reporting for assigned territory and product(s), and forwards to management with information on the selling environment relating to competition, marketing, and pricing.
  • Utilizes OEC’s customer database (Microsoft Dynamics CRM) to maintain complete call records and validate customer/account information.

Education A high-school diploma or equivalent GED is required.

Experience

  • At least 2 years of deal closure experience in a B2B sales role with demonstrated ability to produce quantifiable results through outbound efforts.
  • Experience prospecting leads and placing a high volume of cold calls to potential clients
  • Exceptional sales discovery experience
  • Previous automotive industry or software sales experience is not required, but highly desired.
  • Proven track record of building and maintaining effective customer relationships and territory management.
  • Prior experience utilizing a customer relationship management system (CRM) (Microsoft Dynamics CRM preferred).
  • Completes routine assignments without direction or prompting; receives assistance in the completion of more complex tasks.

Special Position Requirements

  • This is a position that requires candidates to have bilingual written and speaking proficiency in English and Canadian French. Qualified applicants must reside within the United States and hold work authorization in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Occasional travel may be required to attend industry events and customer/team meetings. (<10%)

raw.description:
Grow your career at Cedars-Sinai!

Cedars-Sinai Medical Center has been named to the Honor Roll in U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Hospitals 2025-2026” rankings. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to our groundbreaking biomedical research facilities and sophisticated medical education programs. We offer learning programs, tuition reimbursement and performance-improvement projects so you can achieve certifications and degrees while gaining the knowledge and experience needed to advance your career.

We take pride in hiring the best, most hard-working employees. Our talented staff reflects the culturally and ethnically diverse community we serve. They are proof of our dedication to creating a dynamic, inclusive environment that fuels innovation and the gold standard of patient care we strive for.

Why work here?

“World-class Human Resources" are more than just pretty words here; it is our singular goal. A goal we are making remarkable progress on, and one we hope to achieve with your help.

Beyond outstanding benefits, competitive salaries and health and dental insurance we offer tuition reimbursement and learning programs so you can achieve additional certifications and degrees while gaining the knowledge and experience needed to advance your career. At Cedars-Sinai, you’ll work among our state-of-the-art biomedical research facilities with access to the best physicians and scientists in the Los Angeles area.

What will I be doing in this role?

The Senior Talent Advisor will be a consultative strategic partner and acknowledged expert in recruitment. The Senior Talent Advisor is responsible for full-cycle recruitment of various positions throughout the organization. They will be responsible for sourcing, pre-screening, interviewing, and referring qualified candidates to respective hiring departments. Targeting the best qualified candidates, they will research, develop, and implement effective recruiting strategies to attract and retain a diversified staff as well as provide support to new hires. The Senior Talent Advisor conducts interviews and makes suitable recommendations regarding the hiring of employees. They will also assist the Faculty and Provider Recruitment Department and teams with special projects as it relates to HR functions, as well as other projects as assigned.

** This is a full-time, remote position with benefits, expected to last through June 2027, with potential for extension based on operational needs. **

  • Facilitate and implement the full-cycle recruitment process for academic/provider recruitment for Cedars-Sinai.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive sourcing strategies and recruitment solutions to attract active and passive candidates, considering budget constraints.
  • Maintain significant client and candidate contact during each search, providing timely updates. Collaborate with hiring leaders to share qualified candidate materials and plan visits.
  • Prepare and present offers to candidates, negotiating as appropriate. Remain involved through relocation and transition to ensure a positive onboarding experience.
  • Partner with departments to understand their structure, faculty roster, achievements, operations, and locations to effectively communicate with candidates.
  • Support a concierge approach to recruiting and onboarding high-caliber faculty and providers.
  • Facilitate resolution of questions or issues related to policies, procedures, programs, or benefits, partnering with the Director or Associate Director as needed.

raw.excerpt: Job PurposeThe Journals Indexing Specialist is a global role responsible for maintaining end to end processes associated with journals indexing at Sage.
raw.description:
Job Purpose

The Journals Indexing Specialist is a global role responsible for maintaining end to end processes associated with journals indexing at Sage. The job holder will develop and maintain processes to enhance the visibility of Sage journals by preparing robust indexing applications to indexing partners. The Journals Indexing Specialist will be responsible for collaborating with editorial, research integrity and production to ensure journals are maintaining quality standards expected by indexers and monitor the evolving requirements of external indexing services. Using data driven insights, the Journals Indexing specialist will work with the Associate Director, Research Integrity to drive the indexing strategy at Sage; monitor journals at risk of quality concerns as well as ensure successful applications to indexing services.

Key Accountabilities

  • Independently oversee the end-to-end processes associated with journal indexing applications and coverage of content by working with Production, Research Integrity, Editorial and Legal teams
  • Develop processes to support rigorous journal indexing applications at Sage
  • Create actionable, data-driven insights for Editorial and Research Integrity Teams to ensure journals adhere to indexer requirements
  • Provide subject matter expertise and acts as first point of contact for queries within Sage about indexing
  • Provide training and educational resources for Sage and external editors
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders on behalf of Sage, act as a point of contact for all indexing services
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement and work with Associate Director, Research Integrity to implement cross-functional processes
  • Maintain workflows, meetings, and documentation, to ensure the indexing processes are well-organized and understood by Editorial teams
  • Maintain successful relationships with production and journal editorial teams at Sage
  • Maintain knowledge of changing indexing requirements, trends and overall research publishing landscape

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

  • Extensive knowledge of bibliometrics and analysing citations data in research journals
  • Proficiency in data analytics, data visualization using standard IT packages
  • In-depth experience in research and scholarly publishing and indexing services, particularly a working knowledge of Research Integrity principles and Production processes in journals
  • Experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders and building strong relationships with external partners
  • Evidence of familiarity with searching various databases such as Web of Science, PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and their requirements for new journals.
  • Strong communication skills to translate complex concepts to external and internal stakeholders
  • Research experience, especially in a relevant background such as bibliometrics or scientometrics is highly desirable
  • High attention to detail and organisation skills to manage multiple priorities.

· A continuous improvement mindset

A cover letter is important to us,this offers the hiring manager valuable insights into how your skill set aligns with the role, what unique contributions you can bring to the team and why you are interested in this position. Therefore, when applying for this role online, please upload your cover letter and CV as one document.

Applications without a cover letter may regrettably not be reviewed.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage is committed to Diversity and Inclusion and is an equal opportunities employer. We value individuality and therefore welcome all qualified applications from a diverse range of candidates.

About the Opportunity – Manager, Customer Success Strategic Accounts

    The Customer Success Leader leads a team of Customer Success Managers supporting our High Touch and Strategic Accounts, utilizing the Lever Applicant Tracking System, driving retention and expansion across this high-value portfolio and partnering cross-functionally to ensure these customers achieve ongoing adoption and value from our products. This role carries direct responsibility for retention through renewal conversations, ensuring the team proactively owns the renewal process and outcomes across their book of business. It blends people leadership, strategic account planning, and operational rigor to deliver measurable results for our most complex, highest-value customer relationships.

About the Team:

    The Customer Success team is dedicated to helping our customers get the most value from Employ’s solutions while building strong, lasting partnerships. Our High Touch and Strategic Accounts team supports some of our most complex and high-value customers, working collaboratively to drive adoption, strengthen relationships, and support long-term retention and growth. We’re a customer-focused team that values collaboration, accountability, and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

What You’ll Do:

    • Lead, mentor, and set clear performance expectations for a team of CSMs, conducting regular evaluations and providing timely, constructive feedback.

    • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement, while challenging team members to grow their capabilities and capacity.

    • Recruit and hire talent aligned with our core values and business needs; support onboarding so new hires ramp effectively.

    • Run structured 1:1s with every CSM that inspect (not just review) the full book of business — escalations, OKR pacing, risk/cancellation forecasting, and renewal pipeline — coaching before taking ownership so CSMs build their own judgment.

    • Dedicates regular time to live or recorded call review (e.g., Gong), providing documented coaching on renewal discovery, negotiation, value/ROI framing, and objection handling.

    • Run weekly team meetings covering pipeline, wins, and best practices; audit CRM/CS platform data quality and coach on gaps.

    Customer Relationship Management & Renewals

    • Manage executive-level relationships across High Touch and Strategic Accounts and personally lead or support renewal conversations on the most complex, high-risk, or highest-value accounts.

    • Guide CSMs on strategy, problem-solving, and relationship-building for their own accounts; navigate and advise on complex, multi-party or enterprise requests, escalating as needed.

    • Own the end-to-end renewals process: inspect each CSM's renewal book for on-pace early engagement, confirmed intent-to-renew, documented strategy, and flagged zero-activity accounts.

    • Ensure every renewal carries the standard price uplift position, with exceptions escalated for approval, and drive forecast discipline so churn/expansion fields reflect true expectations.

    • Coach the team on renewal strategy, negotiation, and objection handling; partner with Sales and Finance/Deal Desk to structure terms that protect and grow revenue.

    Value Realization & Customer Voice

    • Inspect the team's value and adoption motion alongside renewals, ensuring every account has a live, outcome-based success plan with playbooks triggered on below-threshold accounts.

    • Hold the team accountable for multi-threaded relationships (documented power maps on top-tier accounts) and treat champion departures as risk triggers; build your own second-layer relationships on key accounts.

    • Own the team's voice-of-customer loop — timely NPS follow-up, documented detractor action plans, and recurring themes rolled up to senior leadership.

    • Own escalations to resolution within SLA, ensuring proper documentation and regular review of risk and sentiment data.

    Strategy and Cross-Functional Support

    • Develop and execute strategic plans for the segment, owning account coverage strategy, territory design, and resource planning to maximize engagement, retention, and expansion.

    • Analyze book-of-business trends to guide focus areas and help the team build playbooks and success plans that drive health, adoption, retention, and expansion (upsell/cross-sell).

    • Collaborate with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support leadership to align strategy and drive retention, expansion, and satisfaction across the segment.

    Performance Monitoring and Reporting

    • Establish and operationalize KPIs, dashboards, and reporting to measure segment performance against retention and growth objectives.

    • Own segment-level results against topline outcomes (GRR, NRR, churn, uplift expansion, on-time renewal rate, forecast accuracy, multi-year renewal %, logo retention) and leading indicators (health score mix, NPS, adoption rate, business review completion).

    • Prepare regular reports for senior management on team achievements, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

    • Track team capacity and make justified recommendations when headcount needs surface.

    Training and Development

    • Identify skill gaps and implement training/workshops to strengthen the team's account management, product knowledge, and communication skills.

    • Ensure the team completes required enablement on time and stays current on product and roadmap; maintain your own subject-matter expertise to coach credibly.

What You Bring:

    • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in Customer Success or Account Management, with two of those being at the leadership level

    • Assertive, positive, and effective written and verbal communication with strong attention to detail.

    • Demonstrated ability to influence credibly at all levels of an organization, including executive and C-level.

    • Fast learner, able to understand and articulate new technologies and their value propositions.

raw.description:
My jsme Teya!

Teya vznikla na základě jednoduchého přesvědčení: lokální podniky si zaslouží víc.

Jsou to kavárny, restaurace, salony, obchody a podnikatelé, kteří vdechují život našim ulicím, vytvářejí pracovní místa a drží komunity pohromadě. Finanční služby jim však život příliš dlouho jen ztěžovaly – zbytečně složitými nástroji, špatnou podporou a komplexností, která je při podnikání jen brzdí.

Teya existuje proto, aby to změnila.

Budujeme finanční platformu pro lokální podniky po celé Evropě – platformu postavenou na jednoduchých nástrojích, propracovaném designu a reálné lidské podpoře. Naši členové na nás spoléhají, že jim pomůžeme podnikat s jistotou, a tato zodpovědnost formuje způsob, jakým pracujeme. Postupujeme rychle. Záleží nám na kvalitě. Jdeme do hloubky detailů. A věříme, že skvělé výsledky a upřímná pohostinnost by měly jít ruku v ruce.

Pokud chceš vytvářet smysluplné produkty, řešit reálné problémy a přinést lokálním podnikům skutečnou změnu, ozvi se nám!

Co tě u nás čeká? 🚀

Hledáme zkušeného obchodníka do terénu na pozici Business Development Manager, který se připojí k našemu rychle rostoucímu obchodnímu týmu, vezme věci pevně do rukou a pomůže nám posunout byznys na další úroveň.

  • Autonomie a výsledky: Konzistentně plnit KPI s minimální mírou vedení a udržovat přesné záznamy v CRM, reporting a dokonalý přehled o pipeline.

  • Akce v terénu: Proaktivně vyhledávat a oslovovat potenciální zákazníky ve svěřeném regionu prostřednictvím přímého oslovování, networkingu a doporučení.

  • Konzultativní prodej: Setkávat se se zákazníky osobně, rozumět jejich potřebám, výzvám a cílům a budovat důvěru skrze hodnotový prodej a dlouhodobé vztahy.

  • Nové segmenty a větší klienti: Rozšiřovat dosah Teya do nových segmentů a získávat větší, vysoce hodnotné klienty a podniky s více provozovnami s využitím (nejen) tvých dosavadních kontaktů.

  • Rozvoj produktové znalosti a podpora týmu: Rozvíjet silnou znalost produktů a řešení Teya, školit ostatní a podporovat juniornější obchodní zástupce prostřednictvím koučování, stínování a sdílení znalostí.

  • Zpětná vazba a inovace: Sdílet a vytvářet poznatky o potřebách zákazníků, konkurenci a trhu s cílem zlepšovat produkty, procesy a zkušenost obchodníků, včetně identifikace příležitostí pro partnerství a integrace.

  • Strategické projekty: Zapojovat se do mezioborových strategických projektů a navrhovat zlepšení, která mají přímý dopad na výsledky oblasti a kvalitu výstupů.

  • Upselling a cross-selling: Budovat dlouhodobé vztahy se zákazníky a aktivně identifikovat relevantní příležitosti k rozvoji jejich spolupráce s námi.

  • Reprezentace a kultura: Reprezentovat Teya jako důvěryhodný, profesionální ambasador vedený našimi hodnotami a přispívat ke spolupracující, výkonnostně orientované prodejní kultuře, která si cení učení.

  • Týmová podpora: Nejsi na to sám. V týmu si radíme, sdílíme tipy a navíc se inspirujeme od kolegů z Velké Británie, Maďarska, Chorvatska nebo Islandu.

Co k tomu potřebuješ? ✅

  • Jazyky:Češtinu/slovenštinu (C1) a angličtinu na plynulé úrovni (B2) – budeš v kontaktu s českými klienty i kolegy ze zahraničí.

  • Drive: Zkušenost s obchodem alespoň 3 roky, silná orientace na výsledky, vedení obchodních jednání na úrovni, plánování, reportování a doručování cílů.

  • Komunikace: Musíš si umět s lidmi povídat, vysvětlit jim složité věci jednoduše a umět je přesvědčit.

  • Týmový duch: I když jsi v terénu sólo, pořád jsi součástí party, která táhne za jeden provaz. Mrkni na náš Instagram @, ať vidíš, s kým do toho jdeš!

  • Odolnost: Fintech roste raketově. Musíš umět reagovat na změny a nebát se dynamického prostředí.

Co za to?💰

  • Férová fixní mzda + motivující bonusy – tvoje snaha se cení!

  • Flexibilita – nemáme pevnou pracovní dobu a na home office se vždy domluvíme

  • 26 dní volna + 3 sick days – protože odpočinek je základ

  • BenefitPlus karta, Stravenky a Příspěvek na Dopravu (Lítačka) – vše, co potřebuješ pro pohodlný pracovní život, od Multisportky přes obědy až pocestování po městě.

  • Péče o duševní zdraví s Hedepy – abychom ti pomohli udržet si psychickou pohodu a balanc.

  • Pravidelné týmové meetingy a školení – dny plné inspirace, sdílení zkušeností, skvělé atmosféry i příběhů našich zákazníků

Chceš do toho jít?

Celý proces se snažíme držet svižný a přátelský – stejně jako naše kultura. Žádná zbytečná kola navíc, ale férový a otevřený přístup.

💥 Přihlas se hned teď a do pár dnů se ti ozveme! 🚀

raw.description:
Job Summary:

AI Central is CDW's hub for AI opportunity activation, providing a single front door to AI capabilities across practices, partners, and compensation models. The Opportunity Triage, Routing & Assignment role ensures every AI opportunity is captured, qualified, and routed to the right resource quickly and consistently.

This operations-first role runs AI Central's intake engine. The role owner manages lead-flow processes, CRM configuration, reporting, and agentic tooling to keep opportunity management visible, measurable, and fast to connect sellers with practice teams so no opportunity is missed.

What you will do:

AI Opportunity Intake & Lead-Flow Operations

  • Own end-to-end AI intake so every lead is captured, logged, and advanced to qualification.
  • Monitor inbound signals including seller requests, partner referrals, MQLs, and customer inquiries.
  • Maintain intake controls and audits to prevent leakage and recover stalled opportunities.
  • Serve as first contact for sellers, providing clear SLAs and acknowledgments.

Agentic Lead-Flow Development

  • Coordinate with business consultants to develop requirements for an agentic opportunity system that automates intake, qualification, routing recommendations, and CRM updates with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Partner with business consultants and technical teams to build out agentic lead-flow.
  • Define human-in-the-loop controls for review, approval, and override of automated routing.
  • Pilot and iterate components; track automation coverage, routing accuracy, and SLA performance.

Routing & Practice Assignment

  • Act as primary human-in-the-loop engagement alongside BCG routing agent for edge cases (est. <15% total opps). Route qualified leads by entry point and practice capacity to the right field SA, Business development Manger, or AI Practice resource.
  • Manage re-routing for stalled, rejected, or escalated opportunities so no lead ages out without disposition.

CRM Management & Pipeline Reporting

  • Maintain dashboards and recurring reports for visibility into volume, velocity, qualification, and pipeline health.
  • Define and track intake KPIs including time-to-qualify, time-to-assign, routing accuracy, and aging.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations/CRM on enhancements and workflow automation aligned to governance.

Process Design & Continuous Improvement

  • Design and refine the end-to-end AI opportunity process from capture through handoff.
  • Remove bottlenecks, ambiguity, and manual steps to scale lead flow.
  • Partner with business consultants to develop seller intake guides, templates, and FAQs to improve submission quality.
  • Run regular reviews with leadership and stakeholders; use data to drive improvements.

What we expect of you:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, CRM administration, or similar process-intensive roles in a technology sales/services organization OR 9+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, CRM administration, or similar process-intensive roles in a technology sales/services organization.
  • CRM expertise (Salesforce or equivalent), including pipeline configuration, automation, and reporting.
  • Reporting and analytics skills to build dashboards, track KPIs, and turn data into recommendations.
  • Process automation mindset with experience improving lead-flow/sales ops processes for scalability and measurability.
  • Cross-functional coordination to run intake/routing across practices and stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Operational detail: data hygiene, SLA management, and audit readiness in a high-volume environment.
  • Experience in an IT services, systems integrator, or technology VAR environment; familiarity with practice-based sales models, a plus.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML and agentic automation concepts to partner with Technical Architects on lead-flow automation, a plus.
  • Experience building or contributing to agentic workflow specifications or AI-assisted operations tools, a plus.
  • Familiarity with CDW CRM/sales ops tooling, compensation structures, and routing dynamics, a plus.
  • Business analysis and requirements documentation experience for operational/workflow automation, a plus.

Pay range: $87,725 – 122,745 depending on experience and skill set.
Quarterly bonus target 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan.

ranges may be subject to geographic differentials.

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

Misión:

Garantizar la integridad y trazabilidad de la configuración logística de buques militares durante todo su ciclo de vida, desde la fase de diseño hasta el sostenimiento operativo.

Funciones principales:

  1. Gestión del Árbol de Elementos Configurados (AEC):
    • Mantener y actualizar la estructura jerárquica de sistemas/equipos del buque.
    • Asegurar la alineación con el Nomenclátor de Material y la documentación técnica (ej. planos, manuales).
  2. Control de cambios y modificaciones:
    • Evaluar impactos logísticos de Propuestas Oficiales de Cambio (POC).
    • Gestionar la trazabilidad de modificaciones en sistemas críticos (ej. propulsión, combate, comunicaciones) y coordinar con Ingeniería y Aprovisionamiento para implementar cambios sin afectar la operatividad.
  3. Validación y auditorías:
    • Realizar auditorías internas de configuración y preparar documentación para auditorías externas.
  4. Catalogación OTAN y gestión de bases de datos:
    • Asignar códigos NOC/NSN a repuestos, equipos y herramientas (usando SICAD/PIDAWEB), gestionar solicitudes de NCAGE para nuevos proveedores y actualizar el maestro de referencias OTAN (NMRCL).
  5. Integración con sistemas de información:
    • Cargar y validar datos en Windchill y EOLO-IACV y asegurar la interoperabilidad entre sistemas (ej. PDCO, CONFI, GLPI).
  6. Documentación y reporting:
    • Elaborar informes de desviaciones de configuración, generar actas de control de configuración y mantener actualizada la documentación de configuración logística.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Titulación de Ingeniería, preferiblemente Naval o Marítima.
  • >3 años en gestión de configuración logística en programas de defensa naval (ej. fragatas, submarinos, buques de guerra).
  • Experiencia específica en:
    • Desarrollo y mantenimiento del Árbol de Elementos Configurados (AEC).
    • Control de cambios y modificaciones en sistemas navales (ej. según Instrucción Permanente de Mantenimiento del AJAL o equivalentes OTAN).
    • Validación y auditorías de configuración en entornos regulados (ej. STANAG 4177, STANAG 4438).
    • Integración con sistemas de información logística (ej. EOLO-IACV, Windchill, CONFI, PDCO).
    • Catalogación OTAN (NOC/NSN) y gestión de bases de datos logísticas (ej. NMRCL, SICAD).
  • Experiencia con las siguientes herramientas: EOLO IACV, Windchill, SICAD, Enterprise Architect o Bizagi.
  • Inglés B2 o superior

🌍 Ambiente internacional de trabajo y crecimiento profesional

📝 Contrato Indefinido

🏖️ 22 días de vacaciones

🔋 Días libres para recargar energía

Con una amplia gama de oportunidades de proyectos y posibilidades de desarrollo interno, tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar tu carrera al máximo. 🚀

¿Te interesa? ✉️

Zenbooks is a fully remote Canadian accounting firm founded in 2015 and headquartered in Ottawa. We serve 300+ small and mid-sized businesses coast to coast — companies in the $1M to $10M revenue range across professional services, SaaS and tech, marketing and creative agencies, e-commerce, and non-profits. Every client is on a monthly recurring engagement. Our regulated practice operates as Zenbooks Tax Services Professional Corporation under CPA Ontario.

In 2026, we were named to the Financial Times’ Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies list. In 2024, the Globe and Mail ranked us among Canada’s Top Growing Companies. Both rankings are based on independently verified compound revenue growth.

We don’t just do the work - we shape the conversation. Our team has been published in the Toronto Star, Policy Options, Canadian Accountant, The Hill Times, Le Devoir, BetaKit, and the Ottawa Business Journal, and has appeared on CBC and CTV on tax policy, small business finance, and the future of the accounting profession. Through OpenSME, we led national advocacy for Canadian SMEs, including a 30,000-signature CRA petition that generated 25 media interviews in five days. We also hosted the Small Business Big Insights podcast, with guests including mayors and executives from Wagepoint, Mastercard, and Wealthsimple.

We are now seeking a Junior Tax Accountant to add to our growing team!

This position is ideal for an experienced tax technician with at least 2 years of experience in Canadian tax, comfortable communicating directly with clients. Experience with bookkeeping is considered an asset. The successful candidate will focus on gathering client information and preparing Canadian tax returns, such as personal (T1) and corporate (T2) tax returns. On-the-job training and ongoing support will be provided to help you continue developing your tax knowledge and thrive in the role.

Reports to: Tax Manager

Key Priorities and Responsibilities:

  • Communicate directly with clients to collect the information and documents needed to prepare their tax returns, and keep them updated throughout the process.
  • Using established templates and processes, prepare Canadian tax returns and tax-related manual journal entries to be booked to the financial statements
  • Prepare tax slips, election forms, letters, Compilation Engagement Reports (e.g., Notice-to-Reader), and appropriate checklists.
  • Apply appropriate credits, adjustments, and deductions to keep clients' taxes to a minimum.
  • Assist the Tax Manager in research of simple to moderate complexity and explain straightforward tax issues to clients.
  • Support the Tax Manager with CRA reviews and audits by compiling the information needed to respond.
  • Stay current on changes to the tax code and accounting principles to ensure accurate, up-to-date filings.

Core Competencies

  • Problem-solving
  • Client-focused & Solution-oriented
  • Unconventional & Innovative
  • Willing to learn, be coached, and develop your tax knowledge

Job-Related Competencies

  • Adaptability & Resilience
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Attention to Detail
  • Project management
  • Understanding of Accounting and Taxation Services

Education & Experience

  • Required: At least 2 years of experience preparing tax returns
  • Preferred: Post-secondary education in accounting or a related field, and experience with cloud-based accounting and tax software
  • A CPA designation is not required, nor is enrolment in the CPA program

Additional Requirements

  • Proficiency in English is required (French is an asset but not required)
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, paperless environment
  • Must pass a criminal background check and education/employment verification
  • Ability to work overtime during peak tax season, as needed
  • Working from home is a requirement

Benefits & Perks

Salary: $60,000 to $65,000 per year

  • 100% Employer-paid Health benefits (medical, dental, disability, life insurance and vision) (including EAP) and flexible health spending account

About Doppel

Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale.

Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges.

The Role

At Doppel, we focus on building a culture where people feel respected, supported, and trusted to do meaningful work. We value clarity, collaboration, and solving real problems for our customers and teammates.

We are looking for a Technical Enablement Manager to own technical readiness across our customer-facing teams. In this role, you will build and run the programs that give Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, and the broader go-to-market organization the deep product knowledge, technical skills, and confidence they need to deliver value to customers, and to stay ready as Doppel’s products evolve.

This is a hands-on role. You won’t just design programs, you’ll deliver them: running labs, leading workshops, hosting office hours, coaching in real time, and building the certifications and hands-on exercises that turn knowledge into demonstrated field readiness.

  • Own technical enablement for SE, CS, and technical audiences across the organization, defining what technical readiness looks like for each role and building the programs that get teams there.

  • Run live workshops, office hours, deep-dive sessions, and hands-on training that deepen product and technical expertise across teams.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities and products evolve quickly.
  • A thoughtful, curious, and resourceful approach to problem solving.

Why Join Doppel

  • Meaningful equity so you share in Doppel’s success
  • Remote first culture with flexibility built in
  • Flexible PTO, comprehensive health benefits, parental leave, and more

raw.excerpt: Who We AreEvergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

As a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) with Evergreen Nephrology, you are responsible for conducting monthly clinical check-ins, identifying and addressing clinical concerns, reinforcing care plans, escalating issues appropriately, and ensuring clinical documentation accuracy across both the EHR and partner technology platform. This position requires clinical judgment, licensed expertise, and the ability to support patients between office visits while collaborating closely with Evergreen’s providers, care teams, and leadership. LPNs are essential to delivering a safe, compliant, clinically credible Connected Care Program.

The program uses SMS as the first-line channel for patient engagement, with phone outreach used when appropriate.

While this position is fully remote, you must be able to work from 8:30am – 5pm in the pacific time zone.

Role Responsibilities

Some responsibilities may vary based on specific patient programs, but this role's primary duties include the following:

  • Patient Engagement & Outreach
    • Perform monthly CCM touchpoints for assigned patient panels.
    • Build strong, ongoing relationships with patients and caregivers through regular outreach.
    • Review patient chart data (diagnoses, kidney disease history, medications, labs, imaging, treatment cycles) before calls.
    • Explain CCM participation and reinforce program benefits.
  • Clinical Assessments & Judgment
    • Conduct structured symptom assessments (pain, fatigue, neuropathy, SOB, nausea, etc.).
    • Evaluate changes in condition using licensed clinical judgment.
    • Assess medication adherence issues, side effects, or confusion about regimen.
    • Identify clinical red flags requiring escalation (e.g., worsening symptoms, new SOB, uncontrolled pain, concerning vitals).
  • Escalation, Coordination & Provider Communication
    • Escalate urgent issues based on defined triage pathways (same-business-day or immediate).
  • Collaborate with the provider team on symptom changes, new concerns, or medication-related issues.
    • Route EHR messages with clinically relevant documentation.
    • Assist in coordinating care: scheduling follow-up, arranging labs, ensuring nephrology appointments are kept, and reducing missed care.
  • Care Plan Reinforcement & Patient Education
    • Reinforce provider-developed CKD and chronic disease care plans.
    • Provide clinical explanation of symptom management instructions (within LPN scope).
    • Support adherence to medications, lifestyle changes, and follow-up instructions.
    • Identify social, behavioral, or access barriers and determine appropriate interventions or referrals.
  • Documentation, EHR Updates & Compliance
    • Document all patient interactions clearly in both the EHR and CCM patient management platform.
    • Track and log qualifying CCM time accurately for billing compliance.
    • Ensure documentation meets regulatory, internal QA, and partner expectations.
    • Maintain high call quality and adherence to scripting and workflow pathways.
  • Quality, Performance & Continuous Improvement
    • Maintain or exceed:
      • ≥80% monthly engagement
      • ≥90% billable conversion
      • High QA/documentation accuracy scores
    • Participate in peer reviews, QA audits, coaching sessions, and continuous education.
    • Identify recurring patient needs and communicate trends to the Program Manager.
  • Other duties consistent with this role, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Active LPN or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) license
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English)
  • Minimum 1–2 years of clinical experience in:
    • Ambulatory care
    • Population health
    • Care coordination
    • Case management
  • Strong clinical assessment, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Comfortable working in two systems (EHR + CCM platform) simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage a structured, metric-driven workflow with reliability.
  • Intermediate skills with MS Office Suite of products including Outlook and Teams
  • Able to work effectively in a primarily remote environment:
    • Home internet must support a minimum download speed of 25 Mbps and upload speed of 10 Mbps. Cable, Fiber, or DSL connections hardwired to the internet device are recommended
    • Evergreen will provide remote employees with telephony applications and equipment to meet the business requirements for their role
    • Employees must work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in chronic disease management
  • Prior work in virtual care, remote nursing, or telehealth programs.
  • Familiarity with CCM regulatory requirements.
  • Strong patient education and motivational interviewing skills.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $55,000-$65,000 annually. Exact pay is determined based on experience, education, demand for the role, and other role-specific factors.

This role is also eligible for a quarterly bonus.

Benefits

Evergreen Nephrology’s total rewards program is designed to support you in and outside of work. You can expect:

  • Paid time off starting at 4 weeks for full-time employees
  • 12 paid holidays per year
  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including an HSA with employer match
  • Reimbursement for continuing medical education for eligible roles
  • A 401(k) program where Evergreen matches up to 4% of contributions after six months of tenure
  • Paid parental leave
  • A robust training and development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career with Evergreen Nephrology

Join the mission to make the digital world safer.

About Team Cymru

Team Cymru's mission is to make the digital world safer by helping organizations track and disrupt cybercriminals, protect critical infrastructure, and ultimately save lives.

We provide unmatched visibility into global internet activity through our Pure Signal™ platform, giving customers insight into external threats at a scale few organizations can match. Our intelligence is trusted by organizations across government, enterprise, and the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

As a mission-driven organization, our work has a real-world impact, supporting efforts that protect national security, critical infrastructure, and millions of people worldwide. We are a trusted partner to global leaders in cybersecurity and government, delivering intelligence that helps organizations stay ahead of evolving threats.

Team Cymru is a fast-paced, distribution-focused, private equity–backed company where your work directly supports a mission that protects millions worldwide.

We're hiring a Cloud Engineer to help run and grow our AWS environment. This is a hands-on junior-to-mid-level role: you'll administer our multi-account AWS Organization, build and deploy infrastructure as code, and keep the environment secure, well-governed, and cost-efficient. Your focus is the cloud infrastructure and platform layer itself, the accounts, identity, guardrails, networking, and services that let application engineers thrive, rather than building or operating the applications that run on top of it. You'll also support our on-premises private cloud, working alongside and learning from the Site Reliability Engineering team as you grow your automation skills. You'll participate in a shared on-call rotation, with clear room to develop toward senior cloud and reliability work.

Key Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure & Operations

  • Administer the AWS Organization, managing accounts, organizational units, and the multi-account structure day to day
  • Administer IAM (users, roles, policies, least-privilege access) along with secrets and key management (Secrets Manager, KMS)
  • Implement and maintain governance guardrails, including Service Control Policies (SCPs), Control Tower guidelines, and Account Factory provisioning, under senior guidance
  • Design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure as code with CloudFormation, using version control, change sets, and drift detection, and take part in the CI/CD process for templates
  • Administer networking and VPCs, including subnets, routing, security groups, and connectivity
  • Manage billing and cost: budgets and alerts, cost-allocation tagging, and rightsizing/optimization recommendations
  • Maintain resource tagging and governance standards that feed cost allocation and AWS Config rules

Security, Monitoring & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Operate cloud observability, including CloudWatch metrics, logs, and alarms, and CloudTrail, and respond to alerts
  • Maintain baseline cloud security services (GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config) and respond to infrastructure-layer security findings in partnership with the Security team
  • Support the on-premises private cloud through process-improvement automation, monitoring automation, and application integration, working closely with and learning from the SRE team
  • Take part in a shared on-call rotation, responding to incidents and driving resolution

● Maintain documentation and runbooks

Qualifications & Experience

  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or an AWS Associate-level certification
  • 1-3 years of hands-on AWS experience (junior to mid-level)
  • Working knowledge of AWS Organizations, IAM, and multi-account concepts
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, especially CloudFormation
  • Familiarity with VPC networking (subnets, routing, security groups)
  • Exposure to AWS cost management and governance (SCPs, tagging, budgets)

Additional Skills

  • Comfortable scripting in Bash and/or Python
  • Willingness to learn on-prem virtualization and to join an on-call rotation
  • Hands-on Control Tower and Account Factory experience (nice to have)
  • CloudWatch/CloudTrail observability and baseline security services like GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config (nice to have)
  • Secrets Manager / KMS experience (nice to have)
  • Git-based workflows and CI/CD for infrastructure as code (nice to have)

Education and Certifications

  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Associate-level certification required
  • Exposure to on-prem hypervisors (Xen, Proxmox) or Linux administration a plus
  • Background in a security- or threat-intelligence-conscious environment a plus

Travel

Minimal to occasional travel may be required depending on team needs.

Why Join Team Cymru?

At Team Cymru, we provide unmatched global threat intelligence that empowers organizations to proactively disrupt adversaries. You'll be at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, helping customers harness the full power of our threat intelligence to achieve critical business and security outcomes.

We offer a collaborative, mission-driven culture where your expertise and impact will directly contribute to improving global security.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply now and help shape the financial future of a company protecting millions worldwide.

This job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve as needed. Team Cymru is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. This is a remote position.

About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We’re currently hiring Senior Academic Advisors across multiple Inspira Education Group brands.

We’re looking for a driven, entrepreneurial Senior Academic Advisor with a strong ownership mindset. Someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and is eager to help students achieve their academic dreams. You’ll play a key role in driving revenue growth through inbound sales, while also helping to build and refine the systems and processes that will allow our sales function to scale in the future.

This is one of the most impactful roles at Inspira. As the first point of contact for parents and students exploring our programs, you’ll set the tone for their entire experience. The trust, empathy, and expertise you bring to these conversations often become the deciding factors in their choice to work with us. You’ll guide them through one of the most meaningful decisions of their lives- investing in their education and future success.

What You'll Do

  • Lead consultative intro calls (inbound) with parents and students to understand their goals, explain the admissions process, and recommend the right Inspira programs and packages based on their needs
  • Own the relationship with prospective students and families from first touch through enrollment by building trust, offering guidance, and ensuring a smooth and positive experience throughout their journey
  • Follow up strategically and consistently to stay connected with prospects, anticipate questions or concerns, and help them confidently decide to partner with Inspira
  • Experiment and innovate—test new scripts, refine messaging, and explore creative follow-up strategies to maximize conversion rates and continuously improve the enrollment experience
  • Close deals across a range of programs and services, meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly sales goals
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the marketing, counseling, and finance teams to ensure seamless handoffs, strong alignment, and an exceptional customer experience
  • Stay informed on competitor offerings and market trends; provide real-time feedback to founders and leadership to shape product, pricing, and go-to-market strategy
  • Leverage HubSpot CRM to manage the full sales cycle—tracking leads, logging communications, creating email templates, forecasting revenue, and maintaining data integrity across all stages
  • Forecast enrollments accurately by managing deal stages, values, and close dates in HubSpot
  • Support onboarding and customer success for newly enrolled students to ensure a strong start and high satisfaction

Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in inbound sales within a service-oriented or consultative environment, ideally with sales cycles under 2–3 months
  • Proven success selling premium or high-value service packages (ACV $5,000+), with a track record of exceeding targets and delivering exceptional client experiences
  • Excellent communication skills. You’re confident presenting, writing, and speaking with clarity, empathy, and professionalism
  • Strong CRM proficiency, preferably in HubSpot (or similar tools), with a knack for maintaining clean data and using systems to drive performance
  • Comfort with data and reporting, including experience using Excel or Google Sheets to build and interpret dashboards
  • Nice to Have: Prior experience in education, admissions, or academic consulting sales

What We Value

As a fast-growing startup, every team member plays a pivotal role in shaping our culture and driving our success. At Inspira, we’re looking for people who embody these core values:

  • Winning Attitude: You find a way to succeed. You dig deeper to understand the “why” behind a no, and you don’t stop until you’ve found a solution
  • Curiosity: You constantly push yourself to learn, experiment, and improve. You’re open to new ideas and you see setbacks as opportunities to grow
  • Genuine Relationships: You lead with empathy and integrity. Parents and students trust us with one of the most important decisions of their lives, and you honor that by building authentic, human connections
  • Smart and Hard Work: You combine awareness and judgment with effort and discipline. You know when to think strategically and when to roll up your sleeves
  • Humility and Teamwork: You celebrate collective success over individual wins. You welcome feedback, learn from mistakes, and support those around you

Why you'll love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

Compensation

OTE: $200K+

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.
