raw.description:
Role Summary

The Pursuit Lead, Elevate owns transformational opportunities end-to-end—from first strategic engagement through close and into early customer success. You are the single point of accountability for deal progression, commercial architecture, and customer outcomes. Unlike traditional deal roles, you work shoulder-to-shoulder with an embedded Transformational Platform Consultant; you own the transformation strategy and commercial model while they own the technical transformation narrative and North Star architecture. Together, you present one unified voice, one coherent vision, and one executable path to operational transformation through the ServiceNow platform.

You operate upstream of traditional sales motions, identifying and developing transformational opportunities that cut across business units and require platform-level thinking, executive engagement, and cross-functional orchestration from our ecosystem and partners.

Six Core Accountabilities

Own Deal Outcome & Business Impact

Drive the complete deal lifecycle as the business strategist and executive deal leader. Own the strategic hypothesis for transformation from initial customer vision all the way through to value driving deal shaping, commercial architecture, and handoff into post-sale. Ensure the deal structure, investment thesis, and success metrics align with the customer's bold transformation ambition, not just a software purchase.

Shape Transformational Hypotheses Using Platform Depth

Partner with the Transformational Platform Consultant to connect customer business imperatives to the ServiceNow platform as a unified operational backbone. Develop a North Star vision that shows how NOW enables measurable outcomes—faster decision cycles, reduced operational friction, AI-accelerated operations, or enterprise-wide visibility. Make the platform's operational impact tangible and urgent, not abstract.

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Pursuit Execution

Act as the single point of accountability for deal momentum. Mobilize Partners, Value teams, GTM, Enterprise Architecture, Hyperscalers, Finance, Legal, Revenue, etc into one unified pursuit with clear ownership. Remove blockers, escalate conflicts, redirect resources, and maintain tempo. Silo'd work isn't allowed—every function moves the deal forward together or not at all.

Build Commercial Models That Unlock Transformational Investment

Challenge assumptions about what transformational deals can look like. Invent new commercial structures (outcome agreements, platform commitments, co-investment models, pricing ramps) that align customer risk with platform value realization. Own the deal economics—not just revenue, but deal shape, investment strategy, and commercial terms that reflect transformation scope.

Create Executive Conviction Through Outcome Clarity

Craft C-suite narratives that connect business imperatives to platform capabilities to measurable operational outcomes. Move customers from curiosity → confidence → commitment by simplifying complexity and making the transformation case irrefutable. Work alongside the Transformational Platform Consultant to speak both business and technical languages with credibility.

Codify and Raise the Bar for Future Pursuits

Every deal teaches. Capture what worked—use-case patterns, commercial structures, stakeholder plays, objection patterns, sequencing. Mine deal stalls for pattern insights. Feed playbook learnings back into Elevate strategy teams. Mentor peers on pursuit mastery. Redefine how ServiceNow pursues transformational business with each win.

Lifecycle Ownership: S0–S5+

Sense Intent & Shape Opportunity (S0–S1)

  • Identify transformation signals: Where is the customer facing structural business change (market shift, operating model redesign, AI adoption cliff, loss of strategic capability)?

  • Conduct deep strategic discovery with C-suite and board: Uncover business imperatives, organizational constraints, transformation timelines, and success metrics.

  • Partner with Portfolio Intelligence to form transformation readiness hypothesis and identify the right NOW capabilities.

  • Co-create the opening vision with the Transformational Platform Consultant: Position this as a transformational moment where NOW becomes the operational backbone, not a software conversation.

  • Sequence ecosystem partners (Product, Inspire, GTM, Enterprise Architecture) into a deliberate strategy before pursuit begins.

Co-Create & Architect (S2–S3)

  • Validate the North Star: Work with the Transformational Platform Consultant to stress-test the platform vision against customer architecture, integration needs, and operating model.

  • Build executive conviction: Craft C-level narratives showing how NOW solves their boldest imperative. Make the business case undeniable.

  • Design commercial architecture: Invent deal structures (outcome agreements, platform commitments, phased investment, shared risk) that reward transformation outcomes.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment: Ensure Partners, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Legal, and Revenue are aligned on pursuit strategy and customer commitments.

  • Maintain stakeholder momentum: Lock in customer commitment to sequencing, investment timeline, and success metrics.

Drive Commercial & Close (S4–S5)

  • Lead final negotiations: Finalize commercial terms, investment structure, and customer commitments.

  • Maintain executive engagement: Keep deal momentum through decision cycles by reinforcing strategic messaging and outcomes.

  • Coordinate internal execution: Align approvals, financing, Legal, and ecosystem delivery sequencing.

  • Ensure commercial integrity: Validate that deal terms, platform scope, and success metrics all ladder to the transformation thesis.

Secure & Embed Value (S5–S5+)

  • Own the handoff to Account Owner, Customer Success, and Delivery teams: Ensure transformation thesis, platform roadmap, commercial model, and success metrics are understood and locked in.

  • Monitor early value realization: Track customer's time-to-value, adoption, outcome realization. Identify and remove blockers.

  • Identify adjacent opportunities: Spot expansion use cases and renewal growth as customer scales transformation.

  • Capture and codify learnings: Document use-case patterns, commercial structures, stakeholder plays, deal stalls, and success factors. Share playbook insights with team.

Required

  • 10+ years of traditional enterprise sales, Software Sales and deal structuring

  • 5+ years of Large Deal Pursuit type role with proven track record closing $50M+ TCV contracts with a focus on incremental revenue vs renewals

  • And/or 5+ years of experience with corporate strategy, business development, large, complex corporate transactions (M&A, IP acquisition, revenue-share models, strategic partnerships, or consulting engagements)

  • Demonstrated executive presence: Credible with C-suite stakeholders in strategic business conversations, not just sales pitches

  • Deep understanding of enterprise transformation: Know how operating models change, what drives customer urgency, and how to sequence multi-year transformation programs

  • Ability to influence without authority: Align partners, internal teams, and customer stakeholders around a shared deal strategy with no formal power over most parties

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists: Complex deals require inventing new playbooks

  • Single point of accountability mindset: Own deal outcome completely; solve problems rather than escalate blame

Preferred

  • Experience originating transformational opportunities proactively, not just advancing inherited deals

  • Familiarity with platform-based enterprise selling, cross-business-unit deal development, or ecosystem partnerships

  • Experience with Office of CEO, Strategic Initiatives, or similar portfolio management

  • Track record of building and mentoring teams, codifying playbooks, and raising capability standards across an organization

raw.description:
Weekly outpatient therapy isn't always enough, and a trip to the ER isn't the only answer. Patients and their families rely on Compass Health Center when in crisis – every day, we help people overcome depression, anxiety, suicidality, obsessions/compulsions, trauma, chronic pain, and other obstacles in order for our patients to live freely.

About This Role

We are seeking an experienced clinician with a passion for delivering evidence-based virtual therapy to adolescents struggling with mental illness. If you are passionate about working with patients to communicate, develop and carry out appropriate treatment plans and compassionate care, you would be an ideal addition to our team.

As a Program Therapist, you will engage with Compass patients as the facilitator of group therapy sessions, and serve as the individual therapist for your own caseload. You’ll work thoughtfully with our patients to develop and implement their individualized treatment plans. This role will consist of conducting individual therapy sessions, collaborating with patients’ outpatient teams, leading groups and guiding patients through their overall treatment program. You’ll partner closely with the entirety of our treatment teams, including Group Therapists, Family Therapists, and Prescribers to ensure comprehensive and compassionate care.

Compass is proud to be a trailblazer within the future of behavioral health, offering fully virtual PHP/IOP programs to patients across the entire state of Illinois. Our virtual programs meet the needs of modern healthcare, providing flexibility for both patients and clinicians while increasing access to fundamental care.

What You’ll Do

  • Majority of role function will be dedicated to Group Therapy while also flexing into Primary Therapy.
  • Utilize Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), and Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) as well as other evidence-based therapies
  • Meet with patients individually to assess progress and guide treatment planning
  • Coordinate care with patients’ individual providers to ensure continuity of care
  • Assess patients’ progress and need for higher level of care or discharge
  • Conducts assessments and consults with intake clinicians to aid in determining appropriateness of fit for patients
  • Communicate with patients’ family members or support system when indicated
  • Complete initial intake evaluations to determine diagnosis and appropriateness for program as needed
  • Chart in our electronic medical records system
  • Engage in crisis management as part of a treatment team
  • Create and update treatment plans
  • Participate in professional development activities
  • Lead group therapy sessions teaching DBT, CBT, and ACT skills

Who You Are

  • Hold the following licenses or certifications in the state of Illinois: LCSW, LCPC, LMFT, PsyD, or PhD with 2 + years of clinical experience conducting individual and/or group therapy
  • The ability to assist families and patients in talking about difficult topics is a necessity.
  • Excellent time management skills, ability to juggle multiple demands simultaneously in a fast paced and changing environment.
  • Skilled at providing therapy via virtual platforms: Zoom, Microsoft Teams
  • Values communication and teamwork
  • Align with the mission and values of Compass Health Center

We are committed to a fair and equitable work environment. The expected compensation range for this role is below. This range includes multiple career path levels across the organization; where you fall in the range is dependent upon a number of factors including, but not limited to, your years of experience, type of experience, location, and education/certifications. Compass reserves the right to update these ranges.

Compensation
$55,000—$90,000 USD

We know job descriptions can be intimidating, so if this sounds like an opportunity for you, please don't hesitate to apply!

Who We Are

Compass Health Center is a recognized leader in crisis-level mental health, bringing passion, connection, and patient-centered care to the Partial Hospitalization and Intensive Outpatient space (PHP/IOP). Based in Chicagoland, we serve hundreds of patients every day, ranging from ages 5 through adulthood, in our onsite facilities or through our flourishing virtual programming. Compass fills a critical gap between outpatient and inpatient care through an intermediate level of Behavioral Healthcare.

A few more things we want you to know: our values are super important to us, and hopefully will be to you, too. Cultural humility, teamwork, continuous improvement, connection, patient centered care, passion, innovation, and agility should be your power sources. Joining Compass is an opportunity to feel fulfilled through a joint mission towards healing our communities.

Benefits & Perks

We know that you will be dedicated to your purpose here. We look at that investment as a two-way street. We are proud to offer plenty of space for growth, and opportunities to pursue continuous development within our organization.

For eligible positions, our other benefits include: comprehensive medical/dental/vision plans, 401k program with company matching, generous PTO (including competitive parental leave after 1 year of employment), and continuous training through CEU seminars and volunteering opportunities.

What’s Next?

Compass is committed to cultivating diverse and dynamic teams who exude passion for their craft, so whether or not you check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply – we’d be grateful to hear from you!

Job Description:

Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) is a market-leading manufacturer of innovative optical and photonic products enabling optical networking and commercial laser customers worldwide. Lumentum’s optical components and subsystems are part of virtually every type of telecom, enterprise, and data center network. Lumentum is headquartered in San Jose, California with R&D, manufacturing, and sales offices worldwide. For more information, visit www.lumentum.com.
Our Cloud & Networking Platform is looking for a Field Applications Engineer (FAE) to join a global team of multi-disciplined technical experts, working alongside Product Line Management, Sales, and R&D to engage customers across our product portfolio, and help develop and drive design-ins.
In this role, the FAE will report to the Senior Director of Sales and serve as an integral part of the sales and marketing team, working closely with sales, PLM, Product Development, and key customers and to encourage and support adoption of Lumentum’s Cloud Modules and components into Datacenters and GPU Clusters.

Job Duties:

Primarily provides pre-sales technical support for the development and implementation of complex products/applications/solutions. Uses in-depth product knowledge to provide technical expertise to sales staff and the customer through sales presentations and product demonstrations. Grows technical relationship with customer. Assists the sales staff in assessing potential application of company products to meet customer needs and may prepare detailed product specifications for the development and implementation of customer products/applications/solutions. May create detailed design and implementation specifications for complex products/applications/solutions. May build a mini application based on customer requirements to demonstrate feasibility of the application, often requiring rapid prototyping and/or product demo for client. May provide consultation to prospective users and/or product capability assessment and validation

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Negotiate technical specifications and performance trade-offs with customers that will satisfy their system and module needs; promoting Lumentum product preferences at targeted customers.
Participate in customer design reviews and contribute to the technical response to RFI/RFQs.
Work closely with sales and directly with customers to collect customer’s requirement and application use cases.
Work directly with targeted customers to bring up transceiver modules at customer sites, troubleshoot customer prototypes, and develop solutions that support end-user applications, resulting in successful design-in of our products.
Develop and manage primary customer product documentation which can include corrective actions, analysis reports, manufacturing test plans, performance improvement plans, reliability qualification plans and reports.
Manage Product Change Notification process (PCN) with customers and engineering
Participation in critical Failure Analysis, Corrective Action & Lessons Learned activities

ESSENTIAL REQUIRMENTS:

This individual must be motivated and should enjoy working in an open, rapidly changing, communicative and team-oriented environment. A hands-on, “can-do” attitude, a commitment to excellence, plus the ability to anticipate change and try new approaches and create innovative solutions under pressure
Degree in the physical sciences, electrical engineering or equivalent
Minimum of 3 years engineering experience designing/developing or testing coherent optical modules and components, preferably active products, and specifically DSPs, receivers, modulators and lasers
Direct experience in product development and NPI processes with either an optical components/modules company or a system OEM.
Practical working knowledge of transceiver hardware including both specification and test of firmware/hardware interfaces.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally.
Familiarity with device firmware structure & functionality is a strong positive.
Familiar with standards documents like CMIS, C-CMIS, Ethernet, Infiniband
Familiar with popular switch/router platforms and ONTs including Arista, Cisco, and Nvidia

Familiar with Python

Ability to speak/understand English is required; written skills emphasized

Pay Range:

P80-USA-1 :$149,900.00 - $214,150.00

With our continual goal of making Lumentum a best place to work for our employees, we strive to offer employees competitive total compensation packages, which may include annual bonus, commission for certain sales roles, equity, and health and welfare benefits.

raw.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Global Partner Engineering and Operations (PE&O) team is a vital part of Stripe’s Global Partnerships organization, playing a key role in our overall success. We manage the technical and operational dimensions of new and existing strategic product partnerships and programs. Positioned at the nexus of product development, engineering, and partnerships, we facilitate seamless collaboration essential for supporting Stripe’s rapid growth.

Our team is a diverse mix of technical and business professionals dedicated to executing operations with financial ecosystem partners. We ensure efficient technical onboarding and implementation, while also overseeing ongoing KTLO (Keep-The-Lights-On) activities and achieving strict quality and performance benchmarks. Additionally, the PE&O team initiates partner-agnostic programs and solutions to tackle broad ecosystem challenges, developing tools that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

In This Role

The team is establishing a new function to oversee Card Network Compliance. In this position, you will be responsible for developing programs and processes to address Stripe’s card network changes and their implications for both Stripe and its users. This role is crucial for ensuring we stay informed about ongoing card network announcements, enhancing our strategic position, and driving operational efficiency in response to changes.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to building a function from the ground up and to help formulate strategies that align with the best interests of Stripe and its users!

What You’ll Do:

  • Implement Release Management Process: Establish a release management process for Stripe in accordance with Card Network mandates, advising all cross-functional partners on the impacts, changes, and timelines associated with network updates. Conduct comprehensive analyses of how these mandates affect existing processes and services.
  • Review Card Network Releases: Review, analyze, and assess biannual card network releases to identify key initiatives that will significantly impact Stripe’s business. Collaborate cross-functionally with various teams to ensure proper visibility and prioritization of these initiatives. Facilitate communication between engineering teams and the card networks' Technical Partner Managers (TPaMs) to streamline clarifications and negotiations regarding complex mandates and programs.
  • Monitor Compliance: Establish a framework and process for monitoring compliance with card network requirements and internal policies. Ensure regular audits and assessments are conducted to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement strategies.
  • Develop Metrics and Dashboards: Create and implement comprehensive metrics and JIRA dashboards to effectively monitor, review, and analyze mandates for each release cycle. Regularly update and refine the dashboards to reflect current business priorities and challenges, enabling teams to make informed decisions and proactively address potential issues related to card network mandates.
  • Manage Mandate Intake Process: Oversee the network mandate intake process, ensuring timely review, assessment, and prioritization of mandates. Lead the proactive management of waiver requests, liaising between compliance and operational teams for resolution.
  • Engage with External Partners: Actively engage with external network partners by participating in councils, forums, and regular strategic meetings. Establish and nurture relationships that facilitate mutual understanding of goals and objectives.
  • Advocate for Stripe: Serve as a dedicated advocate for Stripe within the card network ecosystem, ensuring that the unique perspectives, challenges, and opportunities faced by Stripe are considered by network stakeholders.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in the payments industry, with significant expertise in working with card networks and understanding card network rules and compliance activities.
  • In-depth understanding of acquiring platforms and systems, and their interactions with card network products and processes.
  • Proficient in navigating and using JIRA for project management and tracking. Familiarity with card network portals for managing and monitoring compliance activities. Comfortable utilizing Google Workspace tools (such as Sheets, Docs, and Slides) for collaboration and documentation.
  • Proven track record of effectively collaborating with product and engineering teams to develop new processes and strategies in partnership with them.
  • Strong program and project management abilities, with the capacity to engage and influence stakeholders outside of direct control.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively engage with both internal and external partners and drive change.
  • Ability to thrive with minimal guidance, navigating uncertainty and ambiguity while shaping a new program and function at Stripe.
  • Strategic thinker adept at identifying cross-functional issues, providing innovative solutions, and communicating the implications of these solutions across existing processes, systems, and teams.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a payment service provider (PSP), card network, or high-growth technology company is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Finance, Technology) is preferred.

About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

📍 Location:Remote - this role is available across all countries with 4hr+ overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ)

As our Senior/Staff Frontend Engineer, you’ll build and own major UI systems end-to-end using React + . This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership.

Where you'll create impact

  • You’ll own the end-to-end execution of core frontend product experiences

  • You’ll build and ship high-impact UI in React + Next.js

  • You’ll design interactive workflows that make complex accounting tasks simple

  • You’ll collaborate with founders, product, design, and backend to deliver clarity and seamless integration

  • You’ll help architect our frontend system, component library, performance, accessibility, and responsiveness

  • You’ll raise the quality bar through polish, detail, and deep user empathy

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 6+ years of frontend engineering experience with React ( nice to have)

  • Proven track record in high-growth, high-velocity environments

  • Deep expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript

  • Deep expertise in Node.JS is a big plus

  • Strong grasp of accessibility, browser behavior, and UX best practices

  • Strong experience with writing unit tests

  • Nest.JS and Playwright is a nice to have

  • Experience working with APIs, debugging, and frontend–backend integration

  • Pragmatic, product-minded, detail-oriented builder with strong ownership

  • Curiosity, autonomy, and the ability to move fast with clarity

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$155K USD

  • Equity: ~$40K+ USD

  • Contract type: B2B

  • Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

  • Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years

  • Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside

  • Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone.

  • Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!!!!

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a restructure like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams.
We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.

raw.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Overview

    Bluesight is seeking a Director of Clinical Strategy to support our Compliance Suite of solutions, ControlCheck and PrivacyPro. This role is ideal for a healthcare leader who is passionate about using technology to solve real-world challenges in healthcare, specifically around drug diversion prevention and patient privacy protection.

    The ideal candidate is a healthcare expert who thrives on educating stakeholders, building value-driven relationships, and has deep knowledge in drug diversion investigations, patient privacy/HIPAA compliance, and healthcare operations. As a strategic partner to both prospective and existing clients, you'll help demonstrate how Bluesight's ControlCheck and PrivacyPro platforms give health systems comprehensive, AI-powered visibility into controlled substance diversion and patient data access — proactively detecting risk before it becomes patient harm, a regulatory finding, or a breach. Working closely with Bluesight's Clinical Strategy leadership, you'll serve as the clinical and compliance voice for the Compliance Suite across sales, product, and marketing.

Responsibilities

    • Establish strategic & trusting relationships to advise hospital pharmacy, diversion, compliance, and privacy leaders on best practices for ControlCheck and PrivacyPro
    • Lead live product demonstrations, virtually and in person, walking hospital teams through diversion investigation workflows (including IRIS analytics and case management) and patient privacy monitoring workflows (including multi-incident case review and user watchlists) to help them evaluate and operationalize the Compliance Suite within existing workflows
    • Drive sales performance by collaborating with the sales team to convey the value of ControlCheck's AI-powered diversion surveillance and PrivacyPro's AI-powered privacy monitoring, both as individual solutions as well as how the two solutions work together as a unified Compliance Suite for prospective clients
    • Support cross-sell and upsell strategy, helping existing hospitals expand their Bluesight footprint, and assist sales leaders in developing personalized messaging and strategies to achieve revenue goals
    • Engage all levels of hospital staff, from frontline pharmacy, nursing, and privacy analysts through Chief Compliance/Privacy Officers and the C-suite
    • Leverage deep knowledge of drug diversion program operations (audit and case investigation workflows, IRIS metrics, Continuous Infusion reconciliation,
    • Pain Related Analysis) and patient privacy/HIPAA compliance practices (EMR access auditing, OCR investigation readiness) to provide strategic insight to clients

raw.description:
The Copyrights Specialist is responsible for ensuring the integrity of musical asset data and resolving ownership conflicts for publishers, especially on YouTube. This comprehensive role involves the end-to-end management of asset copyrights, from initial verification and data enrichment to complex conflict resolution within YouTube's Content Management System (CMS). The specialist collaborates across teams to maintain accurate metadata, track operational KPIs, and ensure seamless ownership transfers, directly contributing to BMAT's commitment to operational excellence in rights management.

Job Responsibilities

  • Identify, review and resolve asset conflicts for publishers on YouTube.
  • Utilize advanced asset verification techniques to research and confirm composition ownership and copyright metadata.
  • Perform technical conflict resolution tasks within YouTube's CMS, including ownership share adjustments and removals.
  • Manage processes through the BMAT conflict resolution platform to enhance asset quality and resolution speed.
  • Analyze conflict data to report on critical KPIs, including OK/KO rates, root causes, and territory-specific trends.
  • Research major catalogue acquisitions and facilitate smooth ownership transfers for clients.
  • Identify and escalate findings regarding "bad actors" and systemic issues on digital platforms to leadership

Requirements

  • 2+ years of Admin and/or Copyright experience within the Music Industry is a must (e.g. Documentation or Distribution department of a CMO, Catalog department with a Publisher, Processing Partner).
  • A good understanding of CISAC tools, standards and business rules is a plus.
  • Proven experience in copyright management, asset verification, and conflict resolution within digital content platforms.
  • Strong proficiency working with Spreadsheets and experience with YouTube CMS. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Ability to track and analyze operational KPIs and integrate data enrichment into daily workflows.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Adaptability to a fast-paced environment and changing company needs.

Expectations of the Role

Within 30 Days:

During the first month, your primary focus will be on familiarising yourself with essential aspects of the role and supporting foundational tasks:

  • Collaborate with the Copyrights team to understand objectives and workflows.
  • Assist in analyzing relations between musical works and sound recordings, including detecting errors in the automatic reconciliation processes.
  • Participate in regular reviews of high-impact conflicts and begin utilizing BMAT conflict resolution platform for basic asset resolution.

Within 60 Days:

By the second month, you'll be expected to take on more complex responsibilities and actively contribute to team projects:

  • Coordinate and assess QA processes to ensure quality in BMAT deliverables.
  • Perform advanced operational conflict resolution tasks within YouTube's CMS.
  • Ensure the correct application of client-claiming rules and ownership-share adjustments.
  • Collaborate with various teams within BMAT to understand their operational objectives and workflows.
  • Proactively share strategic insights with the Copyrights Manager regarding conflict trends.

Within 90 Days:

At the end of the probationary period, you'll be expected to manage tasks and contribute to strategic planning autonomously:

  • Track and report on critical KPIs (e.g., OK/KO rates, root causes) and facilitate complex ownership transfers.
  • Become an active contributor within the team, capable of improving processes based on operational experience.

Benefits

You Can Enjoy

  • Flexible working hours and location
  • Flat hierarchy
  • You can make the role your own and run your own development
  • Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
  • Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
  • We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
  • Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest.
  • Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room

Who the FAQ are BMAT

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 250 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, New Jersey, Oslo, LA, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music and the excitement for innovative technology have proven to make a good combination.

BMAT has grown as a company of companies. Within BMAT there are a number of products and services that developed semi autonomously for different players – Digital Service Providers, Publishers and Collective Management Organisations.

Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.

raw.excerpt: About Schumacher Schumacher & Co.  is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry.
raw.description:
About Schumacher

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our competitive advantage in the industry is our people. We believe that our employees are our most important assets. F. Schumacher & Co is deeply anchored in our company core values which are as follows:

  • Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit
  • Take Ownership & Accountability
  • Be Solutions-Oriented
  • Demonstrate Courage
  • Practice Adaptability
  • Embrace Collaboration

We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a 12 month contract and is a part of Data Insights & AI team

Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis.

This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait.

What You’ll Do

  • Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly
  • Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift
  • Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance
  • Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics
  • Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
  • Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
  • Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio

What we're looking for

  • 2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses
  • Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
  • A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
  • Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
  • Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible
  • Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact
  • Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data
  • Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a business context for task automation - automating repetitive analysis to spend more time on judgment calls
  • Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake
  • Exposure to margin, pricing, or demand forecasting data
  • Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury/home furnishings goods

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience
  • Fully remote work within Europe, with optional time in our NYC office (1–2 weeks per year)
  • Direct visibility with the CEO, with real influence on Product Strategy and Merchandising decisions
  • Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego working environment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

raw.description:
Iovance Biotherapeutics aims to be the global leader in innovating, developing and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy for people with cancer. We are pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient. The Iovance TIL platform has demonstrated promising clinical data across multiple solid tumors. We are committed to continuous innovation in cell therapy, including gene-edited cell therapy, which may be a promising option for patients with cancer.

Overview

The Senior Clinical Research Associate is a critical position within Iovance’s clinical team. In close collaboration with the Clinical Trial Manager and/or Study Director, the Sr. CRA will work to manage and provide daily operational oversight of Contract Research Organization (CRO), study vendors, and clinical trial sites. The Sr. CRA will partner with the Medical Monitor and other internal and external constituents to ensure clinical trial activities and deliverables are completed on-time and in accordance with regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and company SOPs.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Independently manages the study start up activities for multi-center, US and/or global based studies.
  • Performs on-site visits (feasibility, SIV, IMV, Close-Out) with CRO CRAs as needed to assess the sites’ and CRA’s overall performance
  • Provides monitoring oversight by reviewing monitoring schedules, metrics and reports.
  • Responsible for the clinical site training and sites adherence to protocol, all applicable GCP/ICH guidelines, regulations statutes and SOPs.
  • Leads or participates in vendor management activities (e.g., Central Laboratory, Central Imaging, CRO)
  • Performs in-house routine data listings review
  • Collects, reviews, and monitors required regulatory documentation for study start-up, study maintenance and study close-out.
  • Supports CTM and cross-functional representatives as required in relationship management tasks (e.g., contracts, study logistics, patient enrollment, safety, data management, etc.) to accurately coordinate clinical study activities.
  • Mentors and coaches’ junior staff new to Clinical Research (e.g. Clinical Trial Assistants)
  • Assists with the development of protocol writing, informed consent development, CRFs, monitoring conventions, tracking forms, and other study related documents
  • Assists in managing and/or leading the day-to-day operations of assigned studies to ensure completion per established project team goals and objectives in compliance with applicable GCP/ICH guidelines and other regulatory requirements.
  • Performs other duties and assignments as required for the overall success of the projects.
  • Duties may change based on the status of clinical programs and the ongoing needs of the organization.
  • Must adhere to Iovance Biotherapeutics’ core values, policies, procedures, and business ethics.
  • Perform miscellaneous duties as assigned.

Travel

  • Ability to travel up to 25%

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

  • BS/BA, RN, or equivalent with at least 4 years of clinical trial monitoring / clinical trial management and vendor experience in accordance with CFR, GCP and ICH Guidelines
  • 8+ years of clinical operations experience
  • Most have experience in Solid Tumor or Cell Therapy
  • Must have strong knowledge of ICH/GCP guidelines
  • Must have strong knowledge of protocol and clinical drug development processes, clinical study design, study planning and management, and monitoring
  • Strong experience managing early to late phases clinical studies and working with CROs and other study vendors
  • Must have excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, administrative skills and computer ability
  • Excellent organizational, record retention, time management, decision making, customer service, and interpersonal skills. Good command of written and spoken English language
  • Excellent computer skills in the following programs: MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Project
  • Ability to “roll up your sleeves” and individually contribute results to a research and development effort

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals to perform essential functions. Please contact Human Resources to request an accommodation.

Physical Demands and Activities Required

  • Must be able to move about inside an office and exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects.
  • Must have visual acuity to perform activities such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures, viewing a computer screen, and extensive reading.
  • This position requires repetitive motion, substantial movements (motions) of the wrist, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to communicate with others to exchange information.

Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem-solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines

raw.description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

The Senior Epic Application Analyst is responsible for advancing the functionality and operational efficiency of Information Systems utilizing their expertise in Epic Applications. This entails intermediate to advanced analysis, design, configuration and implementation. This position is responsible for ensuring integration of technology into effective workflow and process design as well as ensuring operational efficiency of assigned Epic applications and integrated technology. Provides advanced ongoing analysis, consultation, complex problem-solving, collaboration and application support to users. Also responsible for contributing to system training. The Senior Epic Application Analyst utilizes their knowledge and skills to function as a technical resource on Epic and assume higher level project responsibilities. This position typically reports to an ISD manager or above.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Associates degree, preferred

Licenses/Certifications: Epic Certification required

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Four (4) years of increasingly responsible experience in a large, corporate systems development and implementation activities in a wide variety of Healthcare Information Systems (MIS) or similar experience in system analysis, design, building, testing and implementation or a combination of MIS and working knowledge of hospital operations required

  • Industry training and increasingly responsible experience with knowledge and skills in a large, complex corporate Information System

  • Previous Epic or other Health Information Systems experience required

  • Experience in supporting complex problems

  • Experience in assisting other Analysts

  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Epic application support, development tools and methodologies

  • Good analytical skills and technical aptitude

  • Good planning and organizational skills

  • Good communication, collaboration and customer service skills

  • Demonstrated pattern of growth in ability to lead others

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

Systems Development

  • Translates user and department Epic system needs into technical solutions.

  • Performs project reviews and process walk throughs incorporating technical, clinical and business solutions that will enhance user user productivity and department service levels.

Technical Administration

  • Responsible for providing technical knowledge in the support of Epic as well as other software applications and operating systems.

  • Performs intermediate to advanced analysis, design, building, testing, and implementation of Epic and other computer programs and systems.

  • Demonstrates and applies information systems theory, processes and methodologies.

Technical Standards

  • Acts as an advocate for setting and enforcing technical development, application support and information management standards within and outside of the Information Systems Department.

Application Support

  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge and techniques in supporting development projects and complex problem solving efforts involving Epic and other applications.

  • Participates in after-hours technical support by rotating call schedule on a regular basis.

  • Provides ongoing Epic support to users.

Planning & Coordinating

  • Develops, prioritizes and executes projects according to established schedules and timeframes.

  • Maintains an effective level of coordination on all assigned projects.

  • Documents and reports on all plans, priorities and schedules.

  • Informs Manager of status of all project assignments regularly

Training

  • Contributes to the preparation and delivery of training sessions for staff

Communications

  • Thinks, plans, leads and acts appropriately in tactical settings.

  • Demonstrates strong communication and interpersonal relationship skills.

Customer Service

  • Provides effective customer service by being courteous, polite and friendly toward others at

    all times.

  • Acknowledges customers immediately in order to determine need and help the customer

    resolve issue or request.

Other

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education, skills competency, supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor, and resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

  • Other duties as assigned.

raw.description:
At parcelLab, we help leading retailers turn post-purchase moments into experiences customers remember, and come back for.

Our platform is used by brands like John Lewis, AllSaints, Yeti, SharkNinja and IKEA to power post-checkout communication, drive retention, and build long-term loyalty.

We’re hiring an Senior Account Executive (Enterprise/EMEA) to join our EMEA sales team (UK-based, London preferred). This is a true enterprise role: complex sales cycles, senior stakeholders, and high-value deals with some of the most sophisticated retailers in the region.

The role

You’ll own a set of strategic enterprise accounts and run end-to-end, value-led sales processes — from early discovery through to close.

Engage in high-impact multi-threaded opportunities with senior stakeholders across CX, e-commerce, marketing, IT and procurement, partnering closely with SDRs, Marketing, Solutions Consulting and Customer Success.

This is a role for someone who likes ownership, cuts through complexity, and is comfortable figuring things out as they go.

What you’ll do

  • Build and own a healthy enterprise pipeline across a defined region or account set

  • Lead senior-level, consultative conversations focused on business outcomes

  • Run deep discovery and translate customer challenges into clear value stories

  • Build ROI-driven business cases and commercial proposals

  • Navigate complex buying groups, legal and procurement processes

  • Coordinate internal teams to move deals forward

  • Forecast accurately and communicate clearly with sales leadership

What we’re looking for

  • Strong experience selling B2B SaaS at enterprise level

  • Proven success selling into large retailers or consumer brands

  • Track record of closing complex, high-value, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Comfortable owning pipeline generation alongside SDR support

  • Commercially sharp, with experience building value-based business cases

  • Familiar with structured sales methodologies (e.g. MEDDICC)

  • Clear, confident communicator with senior executive presence

Bonus points if you have:

  • Success selling into DACH, BENELUX and/or the Nordics

  • Experience in ecommerce, CX, martech or logistics tech

  • Scale-up experience

  • Additional European languages

Why parcelLab

We move fast and build together, offering real ownership, meaningful challenges, and a front-row seat to shaping our sales motion as we scale.

Growth here isn’t about titles or tenure, it’s about taking on bigger challenges, learning fast, and making a real impact. We’ll support you, but you’ll be expected to lead.

What we offer:

  • Be part of a fast-growing SaaS company backed by strong investors and global brands

  • Learn from a world-class sales team and progress your career in a high-impact role

  • Competitive compensation and commission structure

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work environment

  • Collaborative, inclusive, and ambitious culture

Perks & Benefits:

🧠 Plenty of room for your own ideas...space to try, fail and learn!

🛳 Comprehensive 30-60-90 day onboarding plan in place from the very first day to help you integrate seamlessly with the rest of the company and understand new responsibilities

🏝 Equipped with the latest MacBook or PC, as a digital-first company, you choose whether to work entirely from home, in one of our offices or a mix that suits you. Not close to one of our offices No problem! Find yourself a co-working space instead, and we’ll help cover the costs

🚀 Career development opportunities, including our Leadership Development Program and our Mentorship Program, as well as online language courses and available budgets for further training

🧘🏽‍♀️ Stay grounded with our free meditation, mindfulness and coaching sessions via our mental wellbeing platform

🎉 Regular company retreats, parcelLab events (in-person and online), local and regional meet-ups, as well as team off-sites

🌏 Be part of a motivated, diverse and international team made up of over 25 different nationalities; and with a great rating for company culture and employee experience on Glassdoor, you’ll love working here!

About parcelLab:

parcelLab’s platform unifies every touchpoint from customer conversion, order tracking, delivery, returns, and engagement into one seamless ecosystem that not only reduces friction but actively drives repeat purchases, transforming post-purchase into a competitive advantage.

It’s all in a day’s work for us:

  • Monitor over six million shipments per day

  • 175+ countries across the globe use our tracking pages

  • 1000+ brands use parcelLab for their post-purchase experience

  • Shipping data comes from more than 350+ carriers worldwide, including DHL, FedEx & DPD

  • 150+ employees around the globe, driving innovation together

Equal Opportunities:

parcelLab is an Equal Opportunities Employer. We live the motto always joy, always team, always equality, which means we celebrate diversity and do not accept any form of discrimination or harassment. We believe that diversity enriches our employee experience and allows each of us to deliver the best work possible.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability status or other lived experience.

Come be part of our growth – contribute your ideas and share in our success as we continue to improve the post-sales customer journey for millions of people every day.

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

The Enabling Functions FLIGHT DECK Leader will be responsible for transforming results through the application of FLIGHT DECK, GE Aerospace’s lean operating model. FLIGHT DECK, our lean operating model, consists of behaviors and fundamentals incorporating results management and lean principles to create a culture that is focused on creating value for our customers through respect for people. FLIGHT DECK is how we fulfill our mission to invent the future of flight, lift people up, and bring them home safely.

In this role, you will report to the Enabling Functions FLIGHT DECK Leader, serve as a coach, facilitator, and advocate to the Sales & Business Development and the Contracts and Government Properties organizations to drive the understanding and adoption of FLIGHT DECK.

This position will require up to 50% Travel.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Sales & Business Development and the Contracts and Government Properties leaders to prioritize and solve problems based on voice of the customer and voice of the process
  • Implement and coach the Daily Management process including daily management meetings, Genba walks, and Kata coaching cycles
  • Be a champion of kaizen and facilitate kaizen events to drive improvements
  • Coach and develop team members at all levels of the organization to help them build lean skills and become lean practitioners
  • Coach, mentor and develop organizational competencies to drive effective KPI’s, action plans, and problem solving to drive sustainable results.
  • Delivering step-change performance improvement through the execution of Hoshin Kanri improvement priorities and action planning.
  • Working with colleagues to quickly deploy new, best-practice capabilities and processes.
  • Embrace Lean, digital tools, and rigorous prioritization to drive continuous improvement and increase employee and customer satisfaction
  • Support the function to accelerate problem solving application
  • Share best practices across different segments GE Aerospace Defense and Systems

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college
  • At least 5 years’ experience applying Lean in a global, matrix organization.
  • Must be willing and able to travel up to 50%.

Desired Characteristics:

  • 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, quality improvement, and 5+ years of experience in lean or operations leadership Lean methodology and Six Sigma tools
  • Experience achieving results using the Lean toolset
  • Experience facilitating 5-day Kaizen events, including preparation, coaching stakeholders in framing the problem statement, facilitating the session to identify opportunities and drive decision-making, assigning ownership, and managing follow-up
  • Lean practitioner, capable of facilitating Value Stream & Kaizen events and coaching core tools such as Daily Management, structured Problem Solving, and Standard Work
  • Continuous improvement experience in both transactional and supply chain operations environments
  • Experience delivering Hoshin Kanri (HK) breakthrough objectives.
  • Experience with Change Management and how to drive adoption and develop maturity
  • Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn.
  • Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively.
  • Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed.
  • Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborator.
  • Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker.

The base pay range for this position is $167,000.00 - $222,000.00. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on September 14th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. ​

GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

#FLIGHTDECK

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.


Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

- This is a remote position

raw.description:
PROJECT MANAGER – SAP ERP DATA

THE POSITION IN A NUTSHELL

The ERP Data Project Manager will be responsible for managing the end-to-end implementation of the data workstream within a SAP S4 Public cloud environment, ensuring that data workstream activities are delivered on time, within budget, and meet the required quality standards. The Project Manager will work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, external vendors and fellow project managers to ensure smooth program execution and alignment with business goals.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING (and doing well!)

  • Project Planning & Management:
    • Develop and manage project plans, timelines, budgets, and resource allocation for the data workstream.
    • Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with business stakeholders.
    • Identify and manage risks, issues, and changes throughout the project lifecycle.
    • Co-ordinate across interrelated project workstreams to ensure success of integrated solution
  • Stakeholder Management:
    • Act as the primary point of contact between the business, technical teams, and third-party vendors for data related activities.
    • Facilitate regular status meetings with stakeholders to update on workstream progress, risks, and milestones.
    • Ensure stakeholders’ expectations are aligned and manage changes or escalations.
  • Team Leadership:
    • Lead cross-functional project teams, including business analysts, developers, consultants, and testers.
    • Provide guidance and leadership to ensure that workstream members understand their roles, responsibilities, and timelines.
    • Foster collaboration and communication among teams to resolve issues quickly.
  • Data Workstream Delivery:
    • Ensure successful implementation and configuration of ERP components to support data migration activities
    • Coordinate with other workstream leads to facilitate successful Mock and cutover activities.
    • Oversee data migration, integration efforts, and system upgrades to avoid business disruption.
  • Documentation & Reporting:
    • Create detailed project documentation, including workstream charter, plans, status reports, and post-implementation reviews.
    • Track project metrics and performance to ensure that milestones are achieved and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to stakeholders.
  • Budget & Resource Management:
    • Monitor project expenses and manage the project budget to ensure financial targets are met.
    • Manage external vendors and contracts related to the data workstream.

WHAT WE LIKE ABOUT YOU

  • Experience:
    • 7+ years of experience managing Data aspects of complex ERP or CRM implementations, with at least 3-5 years of experience in SAP projects (preferably SAP S4 public cloud).
    • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and managing both on-premises and cloud-based implementations.
  • Technical Knowledge:
    • Deep understanding of SAP Ecosytem components (S4, Ariba, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud SAC)
  • Project Management Skills:
    • Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).
    • Ability to manage scope, schedule, and budgets in a dynamic environment.
    • Experience with project management tools like Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or Jira.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
    • Ability to work under pressure, solve problems, and adapt to changing project needs.
    • Strong leadership and team-building capabilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 certification.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree is a plus, but not required.

WHAT WE’RE BRINGING TO THE TABLE

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications.
  • Paid time off plan and holidays.
  • 401(k) matching.
  • Short term and long-term disability.
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans with options.
  • Life insurance.
  • Company laptop.
  • Professional career development opportunities.
  • Tuition reimbursement program.
